rule_delta_proposal.text: The shared tail must preserve the operator's explicit float32 scaling rounding point before nearest-even integer rounding; FMA contraction is forbidden unless exhaustive bounded-domain equivalence is proved.
UINT8 zero-point is added after nearest-even rounding. For the magic decoder, keep the FP32 magic bias fixed and encode zero-point in the raw INT32_SUB constant.
Every magic-round instance must prove finite scaled input bounds that keep bitcast decoding monotonic, including saturation-edge counterexamples.

Ingress dtype, signed domain, scale kind, zero-point, rounding order, saturation, topology, layout, handler, mapper and execplan binding are independent release cells; template similarity cannot close another cell.
